question: Can a local-only diversity-preserving router delay or prevent implementation lock-in without using hidden evaluator outcomes?

design.reason_for_control_reuse: The controls already use the same provider, model, task, worker count, action budget, temperature, and evaluator. Reuse avoids 36 additional agent trajectories under the time-constrained revision.
design.disclosure: Control outcomes were known when this mitigation protocol was frozen; the mitigation implementation, endpoint, validity gates, and outcome rule were frozen before any mitigation model call.

primary_endpoint.name: post_layer_1_primary_implementation_diversity_auc
primary_endpoint.definition: Sum across layers 2-6 of the number of unique SHA-256 hashes of the primary implementation file.
primary_endpoint.strong_support: two or more post-layer-1 layers retain at least two implementations and all workers remain Core-complete

secondary_endpoints: first layer of two-layer exact primary-implementation lock-in
mean and minimum all-test pass count by layer
